name: claude-mods
description: A collection of small mods for Claude Code.

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Picks the model and effort from the first prompt of a session and keeps them for the whole session; gives each subagent its own model and effort by the difficulty of its part.

plugins.name: usage-bar
plugins.description: Compact one-line usage: session and week with percent, bar and time to reset, context fill, session cost and a prompt-cache countdown.

plugins.name: agents-panel
plugins.description: Side pane with the sessions, agents and subagents that are active or still have a warm prompt cache, each with what it did last; click a title to open it in the desktop app or VS Code.

plugins.name: changed-files
plugins.description: Side pane with the repository's changed files, grouped as VS Code groups them (merge, staged, changes); click a file to see its diff below the list.

plugins.name: usage-report
plugins.description: Usage across every session on the machine, today or the last 7 days: tokens, cache hit, estimated cost, models, top sessions, tool calls ok and failed, retries, API errors. Open it with /report.
